payout_quote: Chegg has partnered with Valore, to bring you even more options and better prices from multiple vendors, all in one convenient place. Since mid-year 2022, Valore's affiliate partner has been the supplier for all course material fulfillment at Chegg. ... You can buy, rent or sell your course materials in one easy to use site! ... Your search starts on Chegg, but book listings and purchases are now powered by Valore's marketplace. You'll be directed to Valore's product pages to complete your order.
timing: Chegg pays nothing itself; sales complete on Valore's marketplace — Valore issues payment within 14 business days of warehouse processing (check via USPS 7-14 days, PayPal 2-14 days).
eligibility: Anyone with textbooks to sell; no Chegg account requirement stated for the marketplace flow.
catches: Chegg does not buy your book — since 2022 all textbook selling is routed to Valore's marketplace, making this route functionally identical to Valore sellback.
Payout varies per book and condition — the $200 headline is unsupported.
Payment comes from Valore (check or PayPal), not Chegg, and can take weeks.

weasel_words.quote: No fixed dollar amount on the official site — '$200' is an unsupported headline; Chegg quotes no buyback prices itself.

steps: Start your search at https://www.chegg.com/books for the textbook you want to sell.
Chegg redirects book listings and purchases to Valore's marketplace product pages.
On the Valore page, get your sellback quote for the book (amount varies by title and condition).
Accept the quote, use the prepaid shipping label, and ship within 7 days of the quote.
Valore's warehouse receives and evaluates the book; payment is issued within 14 business days.
Receive payment by check (USPS, 7-14 business days) or PayPal (2-14 business days).
biggest_catch: Chegg stopped buying textbooks itself in 2022 — your sale actually goes through Valore's marketplace, so expect Valore's terms, timing, and per-book pricing, not a fixed $200 from Chegg.
notes: Verified with correction: Chegg buyback is now Valore marketplace sellback. Duplicate-in-effect of R0368. Route's $200 claim unsupported.
